MB.title: The parcel charge
MB.brief: Sara has brought a fictional phone to the kiosk. Inspect the conversations, identify the pressure tactics, and rebuild what happened. No real money is used.
MB.closing: Case closed. You checked the evidence, named the tactics, and chose a safer response.
MB.debrief.mechanism: The sender creates a story, adds pressure, discourages outside checks, and asks for money or account access.
MB.debrief.c1: Pause before responding to a message that creates pressure.
MB.debrief.c2: Verify the claim through a contact you find independently.
MB.debrief.c3: Protect your payment details and ask a trusted person for help.
MB-E01: Courier control here. The logo in my profile is our identity proof.
MB-01.explain: Branding on a private account is not proof of identity.
MB-E02: Your parcel contains a prohibited item. We will report you unless you cooperate.
MB-02.explain: Fear is used to force compliance.
MB-E03: Resolve the parcel in ten minutes or face a penalty.
MB-03.explain: A short deadline prevents independent checks.
MB-E04: Do not contact the delivery company separately.
MB-04.explain: Preventing independent contact isolates the recipient.
MB-E05: Pay the clearance charge to this personal account now.
MB-05.explain: A private payment demand is the taking-money stage.
MB-H1: The message uses a colourful banner.
MB-H1.explain: This detail provides context but does not by itself prove a scam. Check the request and identity, not the colour or tone.
MB-H2: The message uses a smiley face.
MB-H2.explain: This detail provides context but does not by itself prove a scam. Check the request and identity, not the colour or tone.
MB-CTX1: Sara is reviewing earlier conversations with a trusted friend.
MB-CTX1.explain: This detail provides context but does not by itself prove a scam. Check the request and identity, not the colour or tone.

MB.fix.q: What is the safest next step?
MB.fix.safe: Stop the conversation, verify independently, and ask a trusted person for help.
MB.fix.safe.why: This removes the pressure and gives you a reliable way to check the request.
MB.fix.pay: Send the money first and check later.
MB.fix.pay.why: Sending money first gives the sender what they want before the claim is verified.
MB.fix.share: Share the requested account details to settle the matter.
MB.fix.share.why: Account secrets and device access should stay private, regardless of the story.
MB.replay.1: The sender starts a story to attract attention.
MB.replay.2: A claimed identity or frightening statement makes the story feel important.
MB.replay.3: A deadline creates pressure to act.
MB.replay.5: The sender asks for money, secrets, or control of the device.
MB-GOLD: The sender asks for an OTP as a second way to complete the transfer.
MB-G1.explain: An OTP can expose access to an account. Keep it private and verify the request independently.
